scripts.architecture:check: npm run build:dev && rev-dep config run --lint-config
scripts.build:release: npm run build:dev && npm run bundle:release -w gitlode
scripts.format: node -e "console.error('Error: Please run format:check or format:write instead.'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts .syncpackrc.json .changeset/config.json .rev-dep.config.json .github/workflows/*.yml CONTRIBUTING.md && npm run format:check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.format:write: oxfmt package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json vitest.config.ts .syncpackrc.json .changeset/config.json .rev-dep.config.json .github/workflows/*.yml CONTRIBUTING.md && npm run format:write --workspaces --if-present
scripts.release: npm run validate:release && npm run changeset:publish
scripts.validate:release: npm run syncpack:check && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run architecture:check && npm run schema:check -w gitlode && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run build:release && npm run validate:package -w gitlode && npm run test:package:artifact -w gitlode
scripts.version-packages: npm run changeset:version && npm run lockfile:sync
